subject: Social Media
title: The Attention Arms Race
description: Learn The Attention Arms Race in one minute.

hook.text: Humans have 16 waking hours. Every app fights for minutes. The war isn't for users—it's for attention.

buildup.text: Netflix said their biggest rival is sleep. Social platforms feel the same. Your downtime is their inventory.

discovery.text: Infinite scroll, autoplay, and notifications are designed to extend sessions. Every second counts.

twist.text: Former designers admit: they used slot-machine psychology. Pull to refresh. Variable rewards. Hooked by design.

climax.text: Average screen time hit 7 hours per day in 2023. The arms race works. Attention is the scarce resource.

punchline.text: They're not competing for you. They're competing for your hours.
